title: Playwright browser verification
description: Checks for isolated, readable browser tests and evidence from failed runs.

rules.instruction: Locate controls by accessible role and name where suitable. Use a stable test identifier when the UI exposes no dependable user-facing locator.
rules.verification: Run the test on the supported browser projects and confirm that it targets the intended control without depending on CSS structure or sort order.

rules.instruction: Start each test with the account, browser context and data it needs. Use independent records for changes and wait for observable states using Playwright assertions.
rules.verification: Run the changed scenarios independently and in parallel. Confirm that no test requires another test to run first.

rules.instruction: Use retry evidence to diagnose intermittent failures. Keep trace handling and retention aligned with the approved test data policy.
rules.verification: Review a failure trace against the expected user flow and confirm that the CI result distinguishes a clean pass from a retry pass.
